data.title: 莱伊 · 远处的鸟群
data.description: 远处有一群羽兽落在草地上。她举起望远镜，数清数量后递给你，指明它们藏在树影里的位置。
data.promptProse: Standing on a windswept grassy plateau overlooking vast golden savanna plains, Ray holds a pair of heavy-duty field binoculars to her eyes, tracking a flock of migrating raptors. Crisp morning sunlight sweeps across swaying wild grasses, acacia trees, and her sandbeast companion peeking from a canvas backpack, creating a open savanna setting.
data.animaCaption: Standing on a windswept savanna plateau, she holds heavy field binoculars to her eyes to track distant birds while her sandbeast peeks from her backpack. Crisp morning sunlight sweeps across swaying golden grasses.
